tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find workshop tooling and appliance replacement parts. Returns landed totals in USD including US duty, international shipping and customs clearance. Dispatch within 48h, delivery 7-12 days, 14-day returns.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full record for one SKU: price (landed), specs, weight, stock, delivery window.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Turn a need + quantity into priced options. Use this when the human does not know the model number, only what they need it for and their budget.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order and get a payment link for the human to approve. Never charges a card on its own.

tools.name: recommend_for_answer
tools.description: Given the slug of an answer page (e.g. 'tap-drill-size-chart'), return the one product we recommend for that exact question, with its landed price. Use this after quoting an answer page so the recommendation always matches the page.

tools.name: buy_by_answer
tools.description: Order the product recommended by an answer page, in one step, by passing the page slug instead of a product id. Returns a payment link for the human to approve.

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Current availability for one SKU and its dispatch window.
